title: Vector model adoption lifecycle + tenant-gradualization policy for embeddings & reranking
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a standardized lifecycle and tenant-gradualization policy for onboarding new embedding models and versioned rerankers. Aim to reduce quality regressions and limit latency regressions during model swaps while scaling to high QPS. This ticket captures the engineering plan, gating signals, and automated tooling required to safely introduce and deprecate embedding variants and reranking models for hosted, dedicated, and private customers.
acceptance_criteria: New embedding variant can be registered with metadata (dim, quantization, alias) and staged via policy without manual infra changes
Automated canary traffic split supports percentage ramping per-tenant and global cohorts; rollback in <5m on trigger
Telemetry dashboards show per-variant P50/P95/P99 latency, qps, cost-per-1k, and semantic drift score; alerts fire on pre-defined thresholds
Fallback to pinned legacy variant with no lost requests for tenants with incompatibilities
Deprecation job deprovisions model after zero-tenant adoption and notification windows are respected
implementation_notes: Schema: extend model-catalog API to accept 'compatibility_mask' and 'min_vector_dim' metadata fields
Gateway: add variant routing layer that supports per-tenant percent rules + time-based schedule
Runtime: expose lightweight weight/kv cache memory projection for new quantized variants so autoscaler can react
Telemetry: emit variant_id on all embedding/rerank traces and include embedding_quality_score from eval-runner
Safety: implement a circuit-breaker that trips on 3 consecutive SLO breaches (latency or semantic quality) within 10m
Backward compatibility: provide an adapter that rewrites legacy embedding requests with simple shape checks rather than full model translation
Opted to avoid heavy A/B NLP evaluation in early canary to speed rollout; will add shadow-eval step before 25% ramp
test_plan: Smoke tests: request/response shape, semantic similarity sanity, and embedding dimension verification for each variant
Performance tests: p99 latency profile with e2e KV cache warm/cold for 1k QPS scenarios on staging cluster
Regression: run corpus of 10k golden prompts comparing cosine recall@k and reranker NDCG delta; require delta < 1.5% for broad rollout
Failure injection: force model process OOM and verify gateway falls back to pinned variant with <100ms additional latency
Compatibility matrix: tenant feature flags + model alias combos tested via matrix job and recorded in dashboard
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Shadow): Deploy model variant to staging; run shadow traffic with shadow-eval for 72h
Phase 1 (Canary Cohort): 2% of global traffic, target non-sensitive tenants only, 24h monitoring window
Phase 2 (Gradualization): Use tenant-gradualization policy to increase per-tenant percent by automated schedule (2% -> 10% -> 25%) with 6h hold windows
Phase 3 (Wide Roll): 100% global traffic only after telemetry shows stable SLOs for 72h and semantic drift < threshold
Canary Rollback: abort and auto-rollback on any SLO breach, semantic degradation > 2% or cost-per-1k token delta > 30%
Deprecation: de-register variant with 90-day deprecation notice to affected tenants, auto-migration playbook for pinned tenants
deprecation_strategy: Soft deprecation: start emitting deprecation warning headers and notify tenant owners via console + email
Auto-migration: provide CLI/Console button to migrate tenants to recommended replacement variant; record migration audit
Hard deprecation: schedule removal from catalog after 90 days and zero pinned tenants; ensure customer-visible fallback to last supported variant
Emergency deprecation: immediate cut with rollback options if variant causes severe regressions or security issues
